title: Lucky in Love
summary: A lottery winner is found strangled at her house. Her friend discovers the body and is soon knocked out. Everyone has a solid alibi.
method: The victim initially faked her death so that she could run away and start a new life. She wanted to frame her husband for the crime because he was cheating on her. The victim was the one who got up and knocked her friend out. Then later when the victim was about to leave on a boat, she was actually strangled to death.
motive: The killer was mad at the victim for the deception. They have a rocky history together because the victim won the lottery and refused to give any money to her friend who was going through a bankruptcy.
killer: The friend who initially reported the murder to the police.
